facts.text: The image is a composite character reference sheet for a character labeled HERO, with one large top scene and seven labeled detail panels below.
In the top panel, a person stands on a rain-soaked urban walkway at night, flanked by metal railings, with wet pavement reflections and blurred city lights in the background.
The person has a short undercut hairstyle with longer hair gathered at the top/back and wears a black tactical jacket, dark crew-neck shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
In the top panel the person stands with arms at their sides and their head turned toward the viewer's left.
The middle row shows three full-body views labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK against a dark neutral background.
The FRONT panel shows the person facing the camera with arms at their sides; the SIDE PROFILE panel shows a left-facing profile; the BACK panel shows the reverse view with arms at their sides.
The bottom row contains four close-up panels labeled FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.
The FACE panel is a head-and-shoulders close-up with a neutral, serious expression and the short undercut hairstyle clearly visible.
The JACKET COLLAR panel shows black jacket fabric and a strap with a metal buckle near the chest/shoulder.
The HANDS panel shows two hands with fingers visible; the BOOTS panel shows black lace-up combat boots on a dark surface.
The top scene uses cool blue-grey night tones and warm amber street-light bokeh, while the reference panels are low-key with a dark grey backdrop.
